opportunities.name: Book-and-film note
opportunities.description: For a book title, look up it on Project Gutenberg (author, downloads), find the film adaptation on IMDb (year, rating), and save a combined 'Unit' note.
steps: Search the title on Gutenberg and open the matching book result
Search the title on IMDb and open the matching film
Add a note 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>' in the notes app

opportunities.name: Country geography note

steps: Search the capital on timeanddate and open the result to get current time
Add a note 'Geography: <country>, capital <capital>, pop <pop>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time>' in the notes app
